Select distinct molecule ChEMBL ID, compound name, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in document CHEMBL5728555. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id. Filter by doc_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5728555'. Left join compound_structures to include canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
